character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A small, wiry green-skinned goblin raider, short and hunched, wearing a ragged deep blue academy hood with a small gold star, stolen as a trophy, long pointed ears poking out of it, sly grin. Patched brown leather tunic, a lumpy leather sack of loot on its back, cloth-wrapped forearms, bare clawed feet. Holds a curved jagged blade low in its right hand. Warm earthy colours: olive green skin, brown leather, deep blue cloth, a little brass. Bold readable pixel art, chunky shapes, dark outline.
